DELIVERABLE AND RELEASE CONDITION
The investigations in Schedule G-1 shall be documented in a final signed geotechnical report before the related foundation design release. Any approved change to the investigation locations or technical substitution must be documented by the Owner and geotechnical consultant. This schedule identifies required locations, not actual testing completed.
